goal: Use Chinese TCM archive-style websites as navigation and topic references, then build an original bilingual AcuTing OS knowledge base that can later support an English public site.

workflow.name: Capture structure
workflow.description: Record the category, article title, topic order, and fields without copying full article prose.

workflow.name: Create bilingual entity record
workflow.description: Create or update the linked entity: acupoint, auricular point, formula, herb, condition, medication, or clinical pearl.

workflow.name: Rewrite Chinese study note
workflow.description: Summarize the key ideas in original Traditional Chinese language suitable for your study use.

workflow.name: Translate and professionalize English
workflow.description: Write natural clinical English and standardize terminology with WHO/NCCAOM/anatomy/evidence sources.

workflow.name: Cross-check
workflow.description: Verify locations, claims, safety, contraindications, and terminology against the source hierarchy.

workflow.name: Connect graph
workflow.description: Link the content to related points, formulas, patterns, western conditions, medications, SOAP templates, and Learn articles.
